title: Database Administrator (Hybrid)
description:
To meet our current corporate needs, we would like to bring to our team a..

 Senior Database Administrator (DBA)

As a member of the Database Administration team you will be responsible for the installation, configuration and maintenance of the INTRALOT Group Databases. Additionally, you will need to think and develop solutions to sometimes unique issues, by using our available tools and technologies. You will also need to provide your support and technical expertise to any database-related problem that may come up!

More specifically, the successful candidate will undertake to:
Administration: in this role, you will install, configure & maintain Databases of various flavors on Premises, Cloud or Hybrid (MySQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server, MongoDB, PostgreSQL), implement database-related security measures, and conduct research for new applications on Database technology for INTRALOT projects around the world.
Operations & Monitoring:  you will be responsible to operate & monitor databases as well as develop relevant operations & monitoring techniques.
Documentation & Support: developing & maintaining technical documentation is a must in this position. Provide 3rd level support services, addressing related incidents and service requests.
Software development team support: assist the SW Developmnt team withdata changes, cloning, relocation, performance issues, query optimizations, configuration changes, updates and troubleshooting.
Escalate to Vendors by opening coherent service requests to request their help to resolve issues.

Key Challenges of our job opening:
You will be joining a team that manages corporate database systems of high complexity, multiple versions and large data volumes!
Handling rapid changes and product transformations which must be evaluated quickly.
Thus, in this role, you need to keep yourself up to date & aligned with new technologies!
Please note that in this role requires to work on shifts, including weekends (standby support)To be a successful candidate, your profile should match the following criteria:
Ideally, you have earned your University / College Degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or relevant technology field.
A proven record of minimum five (5) years working experience
in database administration.
Advanced knowledge of MySQL or Oracle RDBMS is required.
Additional knowledge in one or more of the following database technologies: PostgreSQL, Oracle RDBMS, MongoDB, MS SQL Server etc. will be considered a plus
Good knowledge of scripting and programming languages as well as linux tools, such as Bash, Python, Ansible, awk, sed, etc.
An automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) mindset
You have excellent command of the Greek & English language, both written and spoken 
Completed military obligations for male candidates.
On a personal side... 
You are able to develop and maintain solid technical documentation.You accustomed to working under pressure to meet tight deadlines, whenever needed 
You are also distinguished for your problem-solving abilities and for your strong sense of prioritizing! 
 we work, above everything else, as a TEAM. So, you are an excellent team player, good in communicating and willing to cooperate efficiently with other colleagues!
INTRALOT's vision is to attract the most talented people in our industry and to support and develop them not only to fulfill their role description but also to go beyond expectations! 

About Us: INTRALOT, a publicly listed company established in 1992, is a leading gaming solutions supplier and operator active in 39 regulated jurisdictions worldwide. With a global workforce of approximately 1,700 employees, INTRALOT is committed to redefine innovation and quality of services in the lottery and gaming sector, while supporting operators in raising funds for good causes. In 2023, INTRALOT was distinguished as a top ten most attractive employer brands in Greece.
INTRALOT has been awarded the prestigious WLA Responsible Gaming Framework Certification by the World Lottery Association. We always act with integrity and enjoy what we do.

description:
At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.Pfizer Digital is the organization charged with winning the digital race in the pharmaceutical industry. We apply our expertise in technology, innovation and our business to support Pfizer in this mission.The Biopharma, Patient & CDI (C4) team builds and maintains the platforms and capabilities that enable Pfizer Business Units to connect digitally with our external customers and effectively engage and collaborate across teams internally.  This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services, and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites. We build advanced cloud-based technology solutions at a global scale that positively impact Pfizer business performance.Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs: Within C4, the Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs team is accountable for delivering patient-facing digital companions and external marketplace solutions to increase customer value and simplify specialty pharma services to ensure patients can acquire Pfizer breakthroughs.​The U.S. Channels and Global Web Experience team directly owns and operates Pfizer.com, the operation of our primary U.S. corporate social channels. The team balances the needs of Pfizer's audiences with what Pfizer wishes to communicate, maximizing the effectiveness of both. The team works closely with the peer Content team to ensure the execution of their editorial strategies across all channels, as well with the various content owners throughout the company that contribute material to Pfizer.com.The Channel Management Sr. Associate will be working with fellow team members to ensure the smooth operation of Pfizer's corporate web and social channels.The Channel Management Sr. Associate reports to the head of the Corporate Channels team within the Digital function at Pfizer. Day-to-day, the senior associate takes direction from the Senior Manager, Channel Management to help prioritize and balance team tasks overall. They will also work closely with and receive guidance from the manager-level members of the channel management team who serve as the primary contacts for these channels.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage hundreds of change requests annually for Pfizer.com, arriving through multiple avenues. Requires the ability to evaluate requests and provide direction on standardized/modular design and UI/UX best practices. This role will include monitoring email requests, assisting customers in the entry of content in web-based content management systems, independently troubleshooting customer access difficulties and correction of difficult coding issues, logging of all requests into our Zendesk tracking system, updating and maintenance of other forms of work reporting and tracking.
Must be able to leverage front-end and back-end web knowledgeand experience to make recommendations that affect/enhance functional and user experience challenges on our corporate and global websites.
Actively seek out opportunities to standardize and modularize common Drupal components, leveraging their expert current front-end and back-end experience to make educated recommendations. This includes the ability to prototype recommendations when applicable.
Must be independently able to leverage strong use of image editing tools (i.e. Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator) to perform advanced image manipulation, color-correction, cropping and resizing while strictly adhering to best-in-class compression standards for Drupal/Pfizer.com.
Support colleagues in Corporate Affairs by executing time-sensitive organic posts to Pfizer's various social platforms and channels. These include X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube. Responsibilities also include:

Utilization of the Sprinklr platform to manage/schedule posts and other related content
Assist the Data Analytics team, as an administrator, to ensure tags are correct for metrics and reporting purposes
Proofreading of manuscript and social copy to look for inaccuracies, punctuation errors prior to pushing live
Image manipulation to support all various social platform requirements
Troubleshoot/diagnose/resolve any errors/issues related to social platforms/channels (including Sprinklr and Newscred/Welcome).







BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
3+ years or relevant working experience.
Experience as an individual contributor/practitioner.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to debug and optimize simple/medium complexity applications.
Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment and communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, engaging, and user-friendly experiences.
Ability to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management practices.
Expert front-end Drupal CMS (content management, structure, navigation) development and solid understanding of interdisciplinary skills in graphic design, information architecture, search engine optimization, accessibility and mobile responsiveness.
Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey complex ideas to colleagues and external audiences.
Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, XML and JavaScript as well as other core languages required in the context of Drupal development
Ability to troubleshoot problems and work well under tight timelines
Knowledge and experience with social media and digital communications
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team-based environment and with multiple internal and external stakeholders; influence/negotiation skills and relationship management capabilities a must.
Strong communication planning, execution and process management skills
Strong interpersonal skills to quickly build rapport and credibility with Pfizer internal and external stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Strong use of Photoshop and Abode Illustrator with a focus on advanced compression techniques for web applications.
Any relevant degrees towards these qualifications is preferred, though aptitude in the skills is prioritized.

TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Candidate will be expected to travel globally to Pfizer locations as needed.





Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Associate, Web & Social Channel Management with id 4918591.

title: IT Systems Administrator / DevOPS (IT2024B)
description:
Company Profile
AIMS INTL. based in Athens, is a leading software house, serving successfully the airline industry worldwide during the past 41 years.
Career Opportunities within AIMS
AIMS is committed to investing in its employees and the technologies to maintain its leadership while continuing its steady growth.
Currently, opportunities exist for Senior IT System Administrator. We are always keen to speak with talented, enthusiastic, ambitious and charismatic candidates, so if you believe your skill set covers the key accountabilities listed below, we would also like to hear from you!
We are currently seeking:
IT System Administrator / DevOPS (IT2024B)
Required Skills

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or IT system administration,
Strong knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and security best practices.
Strong expertise in AWS services such as EC2, S3, FSX, Lambda, and Cloudformation.
Experience with cybersecurity tools and techniques, including intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus software, and vulnerability scanning.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues independently.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Desired Skills

Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified Systems Administrator, CompTIA Network+, CCNA) are a plus.
AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
Proven experience with Windows server administration, virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V).
Familiarization with Citrix, NetScaler, Fortigate, Fortiweb, Office 365 is beneficial
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Familiarization with JIRA Software.
Knowledge of networking, IP, subnetting, VLANS.

 Main Responsibilities 

System Administration: Manage and maintain the company's IT and AWS cloud infrastructure, including servers, storage systems, virtualization platforms, and network devices. Collaborate with development teams to optimize application architecture for cloud deployment
Server Configuration and Maintenance: Install, configure, and maintain Windows and Linux servers, ensuring high availability and performance.
Network Management: Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot network devices such as switches, routers, firewalls, and VPNs to ensure smooth and secure data transmission.
Security Management: Implement and maintain security measures to protect the company's IT systems from unauthorized access, malware, and other cybersecurity threats.
Backup and Disaster Recovery: Develop and implement backup and disaster recovery strategies to safeguard critical data and ensure business continuity in the event of system failures or disasters.
Monitoring and Performance Tuning: Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimizations to improve overall system efficiency and reliability.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate documentation of IT systems, configurations, and procedures. Generate reports on system performance, security incidents, and compliance status as needed.
Collaboration and Support: Collaborate with other IT teams, developers, and stakeholders to support software development, testing, and deployment activities. Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance to internal users as needed.

 Personal Characteristics  

Problem-Solving Skills: Proactive and resourceful in identifying and resolving technical challenges.
Attention to Detail: Meticulous in configuring and managing IT systems to uphold quality standards.
Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced environment and quickly adapts to new technologies and challenges.
Team Player: Collaborates effectively with colleagues, shares knowledge, and contributes to collective goals.
Communication Skills: Articulates technical concepts clearly and listens actively to ensure effective collaboration.
Problem Ownership: Takes ownership of issues, ensuring timely resolution and satisfactory outcomes.
Continuous Learner: Passionate about learning and self-improvement to remain at the forefront of IT innovation.
Customer-Focused: Prioritizes the needs of stakeholders and end-users, delivering exceptional service and support.
Ethical Conduct: Upholds integrity, honesty, and ethical standards in all interactions and decision-making processes.
Resilience: Maintains a positive attitude and perseveres through challenges to achieve goals and objectives.

Company Offers 

Opportunity to work with a talented team of professionals in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Competitive salary and opportunities for professional development.
Exciting projects and the chance to make a real impact on the aviation industry through innovative software solutions.
Career growth and advancement opportunities within a growing company at the forefront of technology.

176 73, site: www.aims.aero
